dessin: A data format sheet: one portrait sheet, flat pale #FBFCF8, with a 2 px ink outline and a second thin ink outline offset just outside it (a double frame). At the top, a header band about one fifth of the sheet height, separated from the body by one thin horizontal ink line across the full width; the header band is completely empty, plain pale. In the body, a small simple topographic map filling the body: a few brown #B08A62 contour lines and one river with pale blue water fill #BFD5E6 and thin blue #2F6DA8 banks. Nothing else.
